purpose: Implementation/protocol agreement on arbitrary test pairs, not experimental pose accuracy.

definitions.alignment: Least-squares corresponding protein C-alpha atoms; same transform moves the complete predicted complex.
definitions.ligandRmsd: RDKit CalcRMS in the protein frame, without ligand fitting; conjugated terminal-group symmetry enabled.
definitions.ensemble: Seed-paired, directed left-to-right nearest-of-ensemble (and reverse), and one-to-one assignment statistics are retained with every pairwise result.
definitions.contacts: Protein residue has a heavy atom within 4.0 A of a ligand heavy atom.
definitions.clashes: Number of protein/ligand heavy-atom pairs under 1.2 A; a limited geometry diagnostic.
